summary_rationale: ASE Technology Holding Co., Ltd. is the global #1 OSAT (~27–28% share) undergoing a genuine AI-driven structural mix upgrade: LEAP advanced packaging scaled from ~$1.6B in FY2025 toward >$4.0B in FY2026, lifting Q3 2026 consolidated revenue 44.8% YoY to NT$244.2B (with October 2026 consolidated revenue up 47.1% YoY to NT$88.6B and ATM up 57.7% YoY to NT$56.8B) and breaking ATM gross margin above its historical 25% ceiling to 30.6%. However, Pass 1 blind-spot and filing audits identify four material operational constraints: (1) cash PP&E CapEx of NT$249.8B in 9M 2026 ($11.5B FY2026 guidance) drove 9M 2026 FCF to -NT$115.9B, lifting total interest-bearing debt +53.9% from end-2025 to NT$406.5B (0.66x net debt/equity) and Q3 net interest expense to NT$2.61B ahead of a 2027 debt maturity wall; (2) USI/EMS remains 60% Consumer (41%) and Communication (19%) at 8.3% Q3 GM (~2% Q4 OM guided), though Computing reached 21%; (3) top customer concentration remains 25.0% of revenue (top 5 = 46.5%) with 91.3% external substrate reliance; and (4) Taiwan/China asset concentration (89.2% combined) faces Nov 18, 2026 U.S. BIS AI export rule tightening, U.S. tariff exposure, and intensifying 2027–2028 competition from TSMC's CoWoS doubling, Amkor's $12B CHIPS-subsidized Arizona campus, and Intel EMIB-T. ASE therefore maintains a CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL quality verdict with PASS_WITH_WATCH KPI health.
